presets.name: Familiar desktop
presets.description: A traditional desktop with an application menu, taskbar and graphical settings. A good starting point if you are unsure.

presets.name: Simple desktop
presets.description: GNOME with a focused workspace and fewer visible controls.

presets.name: Hyprland with Quickshell
presets.description: A tiling workspace with three floating islands and a searchable, icon-based Quickshell launcher. The agent configures it for the selected distro.

presets.name: Minimal or server
presets.description: A command-line system without a desktop. Add only what you need.

presets.name: Start from your own choices
presets.description: No desktop or filesystem is selected. Tell the agent what to use, or supply your own JSON choices.
